structured.feedback: The description is about 210 words in Markdown with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing and reviews, and it leaves out weaknesses like the hard-to-open packaging and the pink shade complaint, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split and some generic phrasing in the style section.
